fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

On `/matchups/`, when a user searched with a specific person as the hero or enemy, the match list still showed a redundant Person or Opponent column even though all rows were the same person.

## What changed

**`decksite/views/matchups.py`**: Changed `self.show_hero` from always-`True` to `not bool(hero.get('person_id'))`, so the Person column is hidden when the hero side is already constrained to a single person. Added `self.hide_opponent = bool(enemy.get('person_id'))` to expose a flag for hiding the Opponent column when the enemy side is already constrained.

**`decksite/templates/personmatches.mustache`**: Wrapped the Opponent `<th>` and `<td>` elements in `{{^hide_opponent}}...{{/hide_opponent}}` inverted sections so they are hidden when `hide_opponent` is truthy.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 845 passed, 1 skipped

Fixes #11304
fix.pr_title: Hide redundant Person/Opponent columns on /matchups/ when search criteria already specifies them (#11304)

hero dict is available in __init__; hero.get('person_id') is the trigger condition

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/views/matchups.py: replace `self.show_hero = True` with `self.show_hero = not bool(hero.get('person_id'))` and add `self.hide_person = bool(hero.get('person_id'))`. To also suppress the Opponent column when enemy person_id is set, add a `{{#hide_opponent}}` guard in personmatches.mustache around that header/cell and set `self.hide_opponent = bool(enemy.get('person_id'))` in the view. Total change is ~10 lines across two files.
